resources.string: Load full preset (replaces text, animation and appearance; use animation below for motion only)

Choose alpha and RGB channels. Transparent backgrounds composite over black. An original-video frame replaces the solid / gradient background, not the text color. Animation and duration never reset appearance.
Size 1–160: pixels on a 640×360 reference canvas, scaled proportionally. Multiline text wraps; oversized blocks shrink to fit the safe area.
Compatibility size 1–160 sp: converted to output pixels using this device’s font density. Preserves legacy position and explicit lines (no wrapping). Independent of animation.
Cannot load title preset; no default substituted. Check the preset data.
